stem: What is the best summary of paragraphs 7 through 10?

options.label: F
options.text: Christopher tells his friends Timothy and Rashid that he doesn’t think he can go the whole day without getting into trouble.

options.label: G
options.text: Christopher compares how he is feeling to how the bus chugs up the hill.

options.label: H
options.text: Christopher has a problem that he shares with his friends Timothy and Rashid.

options.label: J
options.text: Christopher is too loud on the school bus and gets in trouble with the driver.
